command:
set -euo pipefail
PRE=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}')
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,collections,os
root=Path('.')
donor=root/'rig_v2_incoming/FRANK_AVATAR_RIG_V2'; m=json.loads((donor/'manifest.json').read_text()); assets=m['assets']
live_roots=[Path('kopf_rgba'),Path('koerper_rgba'),Path('mund_keyframes'),Path('hintergrund'),Path('augen'),Path('augen_rgba')]
def h(p):
 d=hashlib.sha256();
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''): d.update(b)
 return d.hexdigest()
live=[]
for rr in live_roots:
 if rr.exists(): live += [p for p in rr.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
print('LIVE_FILES_SCANNED',len(live),'ROOTS',[str(r) for r in live_roots if r.exists()])
byhash=collections.defaultdict(list)
for p in live: byhash[h(p)].append(str(p))
exact=[]; novel=[]; missing=[]; layers=collections.Counter(); q=collections.Counter(); duplicate_layers=collections.Counter(); novel_layers=collections.Counter()
for a in assets:
 p=donor/a['path']; layers[a.get('layer','?')]+=1; q[a.get('quality','?')]+=1
 if not p.is_file(): missing.append(a['path']); continue
 hh=h(p); hits=byhash.get(hh,[])
 if hits:
  exact.append((a['path'],hits)); duplicate_layers[a.get('layer','?')]+=1
 else:
  novel.append(a['path']); novel_layers[a.get('layer','?')]+=1
print('MANIFEST_ASSETS',len(assets),'MISSING',len(missing),'EXACT_CONTENT_DUPLICATES',len(exact),'CONTENT_NOVEL',len(novel))
print('LAYER_TOTALS',dict(layers)); print('EXACT_BY_LAYER',dict(duplicate_layers)); print('NOVEL_BY_LAYER',dict(novel_layers)); print('QUALITY',dict(q))
print('EXACT_EXAMPLES',json.dumps(exact[:30],ensure_ascii=False)); print('NOVEL_EXAMPLES',json.dumps(novel[:50],ensure_ascii=False))
print('DONOR_OVERLAP_AUDIT=PASS')
PY
POST=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); test "$POST" = "$PRE"; echo LIVE_PRE_SHA=$PRE LIVE_POST_SHA=$POST
